Extracted test files need MODULE_CONTRACT headers — adds GRACE overhead. Mitigation: template minimal contract header for test files.
Benchmarks for tracking DB require concurrent SQLite writes — may hit locking contention. Mitigation: use WAL mode, measure under realistic contention.
Windows support may reveal deep platform assumptions (fork, symlinks, file permissions). Mitigation: scope MVP to CLI-only; defer embedding/LSP.
